mapper.select: select pb.ID as id, pb.PRI_ID as priID, pb.INDEX_NAME as indexName, pb.INDEX_VALUE as indexValue, pb.INDEX_FILE as indexFile, pb.INDEX_TYPE as indexType, pb.INDEX_DATE as indexDate, pb.CREATE_USER as createUser, DATE_FORMAT(pb.UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTimeFmt, pb.AUDIT_STATUS as auditStatus, pb.INDEX_DETAIL as indexDetail from REP_INDEX_SUB pb inner join REP_INDEX_PRIMARY py on pb.PRI_ID=py.ID where 1=1 AND py.id = #{indexId} ORDER BY pb.CREATE_TIME DESC

mapper.update:
update REP_INDEX_SUB
INDEX_NAME = #{indexName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
